I swapped Triceps Pushdown for Low-to-High Cable Fly in today's workout only. Your routine is unchanged. The fly keeps the load off your elbow extensors. Dips and overhead extensions would likely irritate it more, so I skipped them. 💪

Keep the weight light and stay pain-free. Go easy on the bench and presses too, and stop if the elbow gets sharp. If it keeps hurting, get it checked by a professional.
